context.electron_and_energy_closure: no atomic-ion history from this mode; beta electron count balances nuclear Z increase; total Q event ledger, capture photons, beta total energy counted; no immediate heating or Einstein feedback assertion; missing neutrino/kinetic partition stated

mass_convention.Li_atomic_binding_energy: neglected; declared small mass convention approximation
mass_convention.Q_J: c^2*(sum reactant nuclear masses - sum product nuclear masses); beta additionally subtract electron mass
mass_convention.require: serialize actual masses and constants/version used; all Q values derived from this same mass table

outside_finite_network: pp weak fusion and inverse weak bath reactions
other light-nuclear reaction pairs not listed here
context.particle_closure: all reacting nuclei and all produced nuclei/neutrons instantaneously thermalized at gas T; a sensitivity assumption, not a demonstrated transport regime
context.radiation_closure: prescribed soft external UV only; all nuclear capture gamma rays escape and are counted separately; no generated-hard-photon reprocessing

rate_models.constant_S: sigma(E)=S0/E*exp(-sqrt(EG/E)); EG=2*mu*c^2*(pi*alpha*Z1*Z2)^2; log Maxwell integral as PHYSICS_CONTRACT R4, generalized to mu and Z1Z2
rate_models.one_over_v: sigma(v)=sigma2200*2200/v; k=sigma2200*1e-28*2200 m^3/s; conditional continuation for thermalized neutrons
rate_models.photo_inverse: zero from prescribed external 5-60eV support below MeV thresholds; not a thermal detailed-balance rate at gas temperature

context.source_sink_equation: dY_i/dt=sum_r nu_ir*event_r; forward binary event=nb*k*product(Y_reactant^multiplicity)/product(multiplicity!); decay=lambda*Y; x derivative divides by H
